title: mDNS/SSDP/UPnP IoT Discovery Runner
goal: Discover IoT and smart home devices on the LAN by listening for and querying mDNS (.local) announcements and UPnP/SSDP broadcasts, then enumerate their services and management interfaces.
scope: Create workers/runners/mdns_ssdp/runner.py with two discovery phases: (1) MDNS ENUMERATION: use Python zeroconf library or dns-sd to query the local network for all .local service types (_http._tcp, _https._tcp, _hue._tcp, _homekit._tcp, _hap._tcp, _mqtt._tcp, _rtsp._tcp, _daap._tcp, _googlecast._tcp, _airplay._tcp, _sonos._tcp, _unifi._tcp, _onvif._tcp, etc.). For each discovered service record: device name, IP, port, service type, txt record metadata. Identify device type from service type: Philips Hue bridge (_hue), Home Assistant (_home-assistant or HTTP on 8123), Unifi cameras (_onvif), RTSP cameras, printers, smart speakers, etc. (2) SSDP/UPNP ENUMERATION: send M-SEARCH * HTTP/1.1 UDP broadcast to 239.255.255.250:1900. Parse LOCATION headers from responses. Fetch the device description XML from each LOCATION URL. Extract: deviceType, friendlyName, manufacturer, modelName, presentationURL. Identify device categories. Create findings for: devices with no authentication on management interface, devices using HTTP (not HTTPS), devices with default manufacturer names (suggesting unconfigured), devices on unexpected subnets. Add profile passive-lan-iot-discovery: passive, uses mdns-ssdp tool. Add to Internal LAN and Full Internal assessment chains.
generation_reason: Smart home and IoT devices (Philips Hue, Home Assistant, Unifi cameras, Denon receiver, smart appliances) are completely invisible to the current nmap-based scan. They announce themselves via mDNS and SSDP but AegisPT never listens for these protocols.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Passive discovery only. No credential testing. No active exploitation of found interfaces. Listen and query only.

success_criteria: mDNS enumeration discovers .local services including Hue, HomeKit, RTSP, Unifi.
SSDP/UPnP enumeration discovers UPnP devices and fetches device descriptions.
Device type identified from service records (camera, hub, speaker, etc.).
Findings created for: unauthenticated HTTP management interfaces.
Inventory populated with discovered IoT devices including manufacturer and model.

acceptance_criteria: mDNS and SSDP runners discover IoT devices. Inventory populated. Findings for insecure interfaces.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
